heading, Relevant codes surface as you talk, ranked for your framework., level 1
heading, Codes surface from the visit and patient history, level 6

As Tandem captures the consultation, relevant diagnosis and procedure codes appear automatically, pulled from what's said in the room and what's already in the chart. Chronic conditions and prior diagnoses don't slip between visits.
heading, Ranked for your coding framework, level 6
Suggestions are ordered by relevance and matched to the level of specificity your framework requires. Built for the major European coding frameworks.
image, One-click transfer of the completed note and confirmed codes from Tandem into the medical record system.
heading, Review, confirm, and send, level 6
Check each suggested code, adjust if needed, and send them to your medical record system with the note. Missing documentation and invalid combinations are flagged before anything leaves the chart.

image, Tandem Coding Assistant suggesting diagnosis and procedure codes alongside a clinical note, with codes ranked by relevance.
Suggestions account for visit details like age, duration, and clinical context, so what's proposed fits the case, not just the most common code.
heading, Related and complementary codes, level 6
Tandem surfaces associated codes alongside the primary suggestion, so you can see the full picture for each presentation.
heading, More specific coding in one click, level 6
Move past unspecified defaults by navigating to related, more detailed codes, so the code you pick reflects what actually happened in the visit.
At follow-ups, chronic conditions from the patient's record are ready for re-coding, so recurring diagnoses don't need re-entering each time.
heading, Codes surfaced from the consultation, as it happens, level 2

image, Code suggestions appearing in real time as a clinician documents the consultation.

heading, Aligned with your coding framework, level 6

heading, Yours to review before anything's transferred, level 6
You check each suggestion and decide what stays. Nothing reaches the medical record until you've confirmed it.

heading, Catch what’s missing before you confirm your codes, level 2
Gaps and invalid combinations are flagged during the visit, while everything's fresh and easy to fix.
image, Tandem flagging an invalid code combination during the visit, before the note is signed off.
When a diagnosis needs a supporting code, such as an external cause code for an injury, Tandem flags it before the note's signed off.
Some codes can't be confirmed together. Tandem flags these so you can resolve them while the visit is still open.
heading, Everything resolved in one place, level 6
Documentation gaps, code conflicts, and warnings are all handled inside Tandem. No jumping between systems to fix things after the fact.
heading, Codes that stand up to review, level 6
